name: hud_ui_polyline_set_point
description: HudUiPolyline::SetPoint writes a point, extends point count, moves the element for point zero, and invalidates.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4bf8b0 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4bf8b0 validates point x/y writes, pointCount growth to index + 1, SetPos(x, y) only for index 0, and unconditional Invalidate.
The native smoke verifies point zero updates element position and point count, while a later point grows point count without changing element position.
